name: dental-ranking-functions
description: 歯科国試アプリ用高性能ランキング更新システム

scripts.deploy: gcloud functions deploy updateRankings --runtime python311 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --region asia-northeast1 --source . --entry-point update_rankings --timeout 540s --memory 1GB
scripts.deploy:health: gcloud functions deploy healthCheck --runtime python311 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --region asia-northeast1 --source . --entry-point health_check --timeout 60s --memory 256MB

author: DentalDX Team
